How it works

• Study mode reveals the answer and explanation after you check each question — great for learning.
• Exam mode lets you move freely, flag questions, and submit for a scored report with a full answer review.
• Questions may include images/diagrams or log/code blocks, may require multiple answers (checkboxes), or may be matching questions (drop-downs).
• Your goal on these practice tests is ~80% to feel ready for the real CISSP CAT exam.
